quranTranslation.text: He said: The food which ye are given (daily) shall not come unto you but I shall tell you the interpretation ere it cometh unto you. This is of that which my Lord hath taught me. Lo! I have forsaken the religion of folk who believe not in Allah and are disbelievers in the Hereafter.

explanation.bs: Jusuf: „Ja sam ostavio vjeroispovijest ljudi koji u Allaha ne vjeruju“ – svojevoljno napuštanje.
explanation.en: Joseph: “Lo! I have forsaken the religion of folk who believe not in Allah” — leaving by choice.

quranTranslation.text: How many were the gardens and the watersprings that they left behind,

explanation.bs: Koliko su samo vrtova i izvora ostavili! – ostavljanje prisilno, propašću.
explanation.en: How much they left behind of gardens and springs — leaving by force, in ruin.

quranTranslation.text: Unto the men (of a family) belongeth a share of that which parents and near kindred leave, and unto the women a share of that which parents and near kindred leave, whether it be little or much - a legal share.

explanation.bs: Muškarcima pripada dio onoga što ostave roditelji – تَرَكَ za nasljedstvo.
explanation.en: For men is a share of what the parents leave — تَرَكَ for inheritance.

quranTranslation.text: O ye who believe! When the call is heard for the prayer of the day of congregation, haste unto remembrance of Allah and leave your trading. That is better for you if ye did but know.

explanation.bs: Kad se pozove na džumu, „ostavite trgovanje“ – ostavite ono što je inače dozvoljeno.
explanation.en: When the call is made for Jumuʿah, “leave your trading” — set aside what is otherwise permitted.

quranTranslation.text: O ye who believe! Observe your duty to Allah, and give up what remaineth (due to you) from usury, if ye are (in truth) believers.

explanation.bs: „Okanite se onoga što je preostalo od kamate“ – odreknite se potraživanja, jer je tako naređeno.
explanation.en: “Give up what remaineth (due to you) from usury” — give up a claim, set aside at Allah's command.

quranTranslation.text: And they measure not the power of Allah its true measure when they say: Allah hath naught revealed unto a human being. Say (unto the Jews who speak thus): Who revealed the Book which Moses brought, a light and guidance for mankind, which ye have put on parchments which ye show, but ye hide much (thereof), and (by which) ye were taught that which ye knew not yourselves nor (did) your fathers (know it)? Say: Allah. Then leave them to their play of cavilling.

explanation.bs: „Zatim ih pusti da se igraju u svom praznom razgovoru“ – pusti ih.
explanation.en: “Then leave them to their play of cavilling” — let them be.

quranTranslation.text: Allah hath sealed their hearing and their hearts, and on their eyes there is a covering. Theirs will be an awful doom.

explanation.bs: „Allah je stavio pečat na njihova srca i na njihov sluh“ – slijedi nakon 2:6: opominjao ih ili ne, oni ne vjeruju.
explanation.en: “Allah hath sealed their hearing and their hearts” — follows 2:6: whether warned or not, they believe not.

quranTranslation.text: This day We seal up their mouths, and their hands speak out to Us and their feet bear witness as to what they used to earn.

explanation.bs: „Danas ćemo staviti pečat na njihova usta, a govorit će Nam njihove ruke“ – pečat koji sprječava govor.
explanation.en: “This day We seal up their mouths, and their hands speak out to Us” — a seal that bars speech.

quranTranslation.text: Hast thou seen him who maketh his desire his god, and Allah sendeth him astray purposely, and sealeth up his hearing and his heart, and setteth on his sight a covering? Then who will lead him after Allah (hath condemned him)? Will ye not then heed?

explanation.bs: Onaj ko je strast svoju uzeo za boga – „i stavio pečat na njegov sluh i njegovo srce“ – pečat kao posljedica.
explanation.en: The one who takes his desire as his god — “and sealeth up his hearing and his heart” — the seal as a consequence.

quranTranslation.text: Then because of their breaking of their covenant, and their disbelieving in the revelations of Allah, and their slaying of the prophets wrongfully, and their saying: Our hearts are hardened - Nay, but Allah set a seal upon them for their disbelief, so that they believe not save a few -

explanation.bs: „Allah je na njima utisnuo pečat zbog njihova nevjerovanja“ – uzrok je izrečen.
explanation.en: “Allah set a seal upon them for their disbelief” — the cause is stated.

quranTranslation.text: Those who wrangle concerning the revelations of Allah without any warrant that hath come unto them, it is greatly hateful in the sight of Allah and in the sight of those who believe. Thus doth Allah print on every arrogant, disdainful heart.

explanation.bs: „Tako Allah utiskuje pečat na srce svakog oholog silnika“ – pečat kao posljedica oholosti.
explanation.en: “Thus doth Allah print on every arrogant, disdainful heart” — the imprint as the result of arrogance.

quranTranslation.text: They are content that they should be with the useless and their hearts are sealed, so that they apprehend not.

explanation.bs: Zadovoljili su se da ostanu s onima koji izostaju, „i na srca im je utisnut pečat“.
explanation.en: They were content to be with those who stay behind, “and their hearts are sealed”.

quranTranslation.text: And the moon when she followeth him,

explanation.bs: „I tako mi Mjeseca kad ga slijedi“ – osnovno značenje: ići za nečim.
explanation.en: “And the moon when she followeth him” — the root sense: to follow after.

quranTranslation.text: Recite that which hath been inspired in thee of the Scripture, and establish worship. Lo! worship preserveth from lewdness and iniquity, but verily remembrance of Allah is more important. And Allah knoweth what ye do.

explanation.bs: „Kazuj ono što ti je od Knjige objavljeno“ – kazivanje objave.
explanation.en: “Recite that which hath been inspired in thee of the Scripture” — reciting the revelation.

quranTranslation.text: Read: In the name of thy Lord Who createth,

explanation.bs: „Čitaj u ime svoga Gospodara, Koji je stvorio“ – naredba اقْرَأْ, od قَرَأَ.
explanation.en: “Read: In the name of thy Lord Who createth” — the command اقْرَأْ, from قَرَأَ.

quranTranslation.text: And when thou recitest the Qur'an, seek refuge in Allah from Satan the outcast.

explanation.bs: „Kada čitaš Kur'an, traži zaštitu kod Allaha od protjeranog šejtana“ – قَرَأَ se kaže i za Kur'an, a ne samo za druge tekstove.
explanation.en: “And when thou recitest (قَرَأْتَ) the Qur'an, seek refuge in Allah from Satan the outcast” — قَرَأَ is said of the Quran too, not only of other texts.

quranTranslation.text: Or add (a little) thereto - and chant the Qur'an in measure,

explanation.bs: „I izgovaraj Kur'an polagano i razgovijetno (وَرَتِّلِ الْقُرْآنَ تَرْتِيلًا)“ – način izgovora, a ne samo čitanje.
explanation.en: “And chant the Qur'an in measure (وَرَتِّلِ الْقُرْآنَ تَرْتِيلًا)” — a manner of reciting, not reciting alone.

quranTranslation.text: And those who disbelieve say: Why is the Qur'an not revealed unto him all at once? (It is revealed) thus that We may strengthen thy heart therewith; and We have arranged it in right order.

explanation.bs: „I Mi smo ga uredno, postupno izložili (وَرَتَّلْنَاهُ تَرْتِيلًا)“ – Allah govori o Kur'anu; mufessiri to tumače kao objavljivanje dio po dio, uredno.
explanation.en: “And We have arranged it in right order (وَرَتَّلْنَاهُ تَرْتِيلًا)” — Allah speaks of the Quran; mufassirun explain it as revealing it part by part, in order.

quranTranslation.text: And of His signs is this: He created you of dust, and behold you human beings, ranging widely!

explanation.bs: „Od Njegovih znakova je to što vas je stvorio od prašine, a vi ste onda ljudi koji se razilaze po zemlji.“
explanation.en: “And of His signs is this: He created you of dust, and behold you human beings, ranging widely!”

quranTranslation.text: Lo! the likeness of Jesus with Allah is as the likeness of Adam. He created him of dust, then He said unto him: Be! and he is.

explanation.bs: „Primjer Ise kod Allaha isti je kao primjer Adema: stvorio ga je od prašine, zatim mu rekao: Budi! – i on bude.“
explanation.en: “Lo! the likeness of Jesus with Allah is as the likeness of Adam. He created him of dust, then He said unto him: Be! and he is.”

quranTranslation.text: When we are dead and have become dust (shall we be brought back again)? That would be a far return!

explanation.bs: Poricatelji: „Zar kad pomremo i postanemo prašina…? To je dalek povratak!“
explanation.en: The deniers: “When we are dead and have become dust (shall we be brought back again)? That would be a far return!”

quranTranslation.text: When thy Lord said unto the angels: Lo! I am about to create a mortal out of mire,

explanation.bs: „Ja ću, zaista, stvoriti čovjeka od ilovače.“
explanation.en: “Lo! I am about to create a mortal out of mire (مِّن طِينٍ).”

quranTranslation.text: Then ask them (O Muhammad): Are they stronger as a creation, or those (others) whom we have created? Lo! We created them of plastic clay.

explanation.bs: „Njih smo, zaista, stvorili od ilovače koja se lijepi (مِّن طِينٍ لَّازِبٍ)“ – ilovača s vodom, koja se lijepi.
explanation.en: “Lo! We created them of plastic clay (مِّن طِينٍ لَّازِبٍ)” — clay with water, which clings.

quranTranslation.text: And Pharaoh said: O chiefs! I know not that ye have a god other than me, so kindle for me (a fire), O Haman, to bake the mud; and set up for me a lofty tower in order that I may survey the god of Moses; and lo! I deem him of the liars.

explanation.bs: Faraon: „Zapali mi, Hamane, vatru nad ilovačom“ – ista riječ za građu.
explanation.en: Pharaoh: “Kindle for me (a fire), O Haman, to bake the mud (عَلَى الطِّينِ)” — the same word for building material.

quranTranslation.text: He created man of clay like the potter's,

explanation.bs: „Stvorio je čovjeka od suhe zvonke gline, poput grnčarije“ – suha, tvrda glina.
explanation.en: “He created man of clay (صَلْصَالٍ) like the potter's” — dry, hard clay.

quranTranslation.text: And (remember) when thy Lord said unto the angels: Lo! I am creating a mortal out of potter's clay of black mud altered,

explanation.bs: „Ja ću od suhe zvonke gline, od blata crnog i ustajalog, stvoriti ljudsko biće“ – riječi upućene melekima.
explanation.en: “Lo! I am creating a mortal out of potter's clay of black mud altered” — words to the angels.

quranTranslation.text: And because the Hour will come, there is no doubt thereof; and because Allah will raise those who are in the graves.

explanation.bs: „…i da će Allah proživjeti one koji su u grobovima.“
explanation.en: “…and because Allah will raise those who are in the graves.”

quranTranslation.text: And the sepulchres are overturned,

explanation.bs: „I kad grobovi budu ispreturani“ – proživljenje iz grobova.
explanation.en: “And the sepulchres (الْقُبُورُ) are overturned” — the raising from the graves.

quranTranslation.text: Knoweth he not that, when the contents of the graves are poured forth

explanation.bs: „Zar on ne zna – kad bude izvrnuto ono što je u grobovima…“ – ar-Rāġib: ukazuje na proživljenje.
explanation.en: “Knoweth he not that, when the contents of the graves are poured forth…” — ar-Rāġib: it points to the raising.

quranTranslation.text: And the trumpet is blown and lo! from the graves they hie unto their Lord,

explanation.bs: „I kad se zapuše u rog, oni će, gle, iz grobišta pohrliti ka svome Gospodaru“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “And the trumpet is blown and lo! from the graves (مِّنَ الْأَجْدَاثِ) they hie unto their Lord” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: The day when they come forth from the graves in haste, as racing to a goal,

explanation.bs: „Na Dan kada će iz grobišta izlaziti žureći“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “The day when they come forth from the graves (الْأَجْدَاثِ) in haste” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: With downcast eyes, they come forth from the graves as they were locusts spread abroad,

explanation.bs: „Oborenih pogleda izlazit će iz grobišta kao da su raštrkani skakavci.“
explanation.en: “With downcast eyes, they come forth from the graves (الْأَجْدَاثِ) as they were locusts spread abroad.”

quranTranslation.text: (Remember) when Abraham said unto his father Azar: Takest thou idols for gods? Lo! I see thee and thy folk in error manifest.

explanation.bs: Ibrahim ocu Azeru: „Zar kipove uzimaš za božanstva? …“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: Abraham to his father Azar: “Takest thou idols for gods?” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: And, by Allah, I shall circumvent your idols after ye have gone away and turned your backs.

explanation.bs: Ibrahim: „Tako mi Allaha, smislit ću nešto protiv vaših kipova …“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: Abraham: “And, by Allah, I shall circumvent your idols” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: They said: We worship idols, and are ever devoted unto them.

explanation.bs: „Rekli su: ‚Obožavamo kipove i ostajemo im predani‘“ – Ibrahimov narod.
explanation.en: “They said: We worship idols, and are ever devoted unto them” — Abraham's people.

quranTranslation.text: Ye serve instead of Allah only idols, and ye only invent a lie. Lo! those whom ye serve instead of Allah own no provision for you. So seek your provision from Allah, and serve Him, and give thanks unto Him, (for) unto Him ye will be brought back.

explanation.bs: Ibrahim: „Vi mimo Allaha obožavate samo idole i izmišljate laž …“
explanation.en: Abraham: “Ye serve instead of Allah only idols [awṯān], and ye only invent a lie”

quranTranslation.text: He said: Ye have chosen only idols instead of Allah. The love between you is only in the life of the world. Then on the Day of Resurrection ye will deny each other and curse each other, and your abode will be the Fire, and ye will have no helpers.

explanation.bs: „Vi ste mimo Allaha uzeli samo idole …“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “Ye have chosen only idols [awṯān] instead of Allah.” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: That (is the command). And whoso magnifieth the sacred things of Allah, it will be well for him in the sight of his Lord. The cattle are lawful unto you save that which hath been told you. So shun the filth of idols, and shun lying speech,

explanation.bs: „… pa klonite se prljavštine idola i klonite se lažnog govora“
explanation.en: “So shun the filth of idols [awṯān], and shun lying speech”

quranTranslation.text: When he said unto his father and his folk: What are these images unto which ye pay devotion?

explanation.bs: Ibrahim ocu i svome narodu: „Kakvi su to likovi kojima ste vi predani?“
explanation.en: Abraham to his father and his folk: “What are these images unto which ye pay devotion?”

quranTranslation.text: They made for him what he willed: synagogues and statues, basins like wells and boilers built into the ground. Give thanks, O House of David! Few of My bondmen are thankful.

explanation.bs: „Izrađivali su mu što god je htio: mihrabe i likove, zdjele kao bazene i kotlove nepomične …“ – džini Sulejmanu; ovdje likovi nisu predmet obožavanja.
explanation.en: “They made for him what he willed: synagogues and statues [tamāṯīl], basins like wells and boilers built into the ground” — the jinn for Solomon; here the images are not objects of worship.

quranTranslation.text: And be not like unto her who unravelleth the thread, after she hath made it strong, to thin filaments, making your oaths a deceit between you because of a nation being more numerous than (another) nation. Allah only trieth you thereby, and He verily will explain to you on the Day of Resurrection that wherein ye differed.

explanation.bs: „I ne budite kao ona koja je raspredala svoju pređu, nakon što ju je čvrsto ispredla, u niti …“ – osnovna slika glagola, uz zakletve u istom odlomku.
explanation.en: “And be not like unto her who unravelleth the thread, after she hath made it strong, to thin filaments” — the verb's basic image, beside oaths in the same passage.

quranTranslation.text: Those who break the covenant of Allah after ratifying it, and sever that which Allah ordered to be joined, and (who) make mischief in the earth: Those are they who are the losers.

explanation.bs: „Oni koji raskidaju Allahov ugovor nakon što su ga potvrdili …“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ‚koji raskidaju Allahov ugovor‘.
explanation.en: “Those who break the covenant of Allah after ratifying it” — ar-Rāġib cites ‘who break the covenant of Allah’.

quranTranslation.text: But when We did remove from them the terror for a term which they must reach, behold! they broke their covenant.

explanation.bs: Kad bi Allah od njih otklonio kaznu do roka do kojeg su imali stići, oni bi odmah pogazili datu riječ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: When Allah lifted the punishment from them for a term they were to reach, they at once went back on their word — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

gloss.en: to go back on (an oath, a pledge)

quranTranslation.text: And if they break their pledges after their treaty (hath been made with you) and assail your religion, then fight the heads of disbelief - Lo! they have no binding oaths - in order that they may desist.

explanation.bs: Ako pogaze svoje zakletve nakon ugovora i napadnu vašu vjeru … – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: If they go back on their oaths after their treaty and assail your religion … — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

gloss.en: to go back on (an oath, a pledge)
